name: dumbbell seated preacher curl
description: Seated at a preacher bench, you curl dumbbells with your upper arms on the pad. It keeps tension on the biceps.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Start with your arms almost straight.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
